topics.name: Write a program to move a data block starting at Memory Location X to Location Y without overlap. X, Y and block length are to be specified
Write a program to move a data block starting at Memory Location X to Location Y with overlap. X, Y and block length are to be specified
Write a program to perform an addition of two 8 bit numbers stored at locations X and Y.
Write a program to perform subtraction of two 8 bit numbers stored at location X and Y.
Find the product of two unsigned binary numbers stored at location X and X+1
Write a program division of two Binary Numbers stored at location X and X+1. Display the quotient in address field and remainder in data field

Write a program to find the smallest of N one byte numbers. Value of N is stored at location X and the numbers from location X+1. Display the smallest number in the data field and its address in the address field
Write a program to display a MOD N binary up counter and down counter. Display the count in address/data field. Generate a 0.5 sec delay between the counts. If clock frequency is 3 MHz
Configure ports A, B, C in the output mode in 8155 without timer operation and observe the output with the help of LEDs
Configure ports A, B, C in the input mode in 8155 with the help of LEDs without timer operation and observe the output.
Configure ports A, B, C in the output mode in 8255 without timer operation and observe the output with the help of LEDs
Configure ports A, B, C in the input mode in 8255 with the help of LEDs without timer operation and observe the output
Configure ports A, B, C in the output mode in 8255 without timer operation and code for getting square signal & observe the output with the help of LEDs
Stepper motor Interfacing/Speed Control & Direction Control using 8085 and 8051
Write the Embedded C Program and Assembly Program to Display “EMBEDDED LAB” on LCD and compare Output of both program and draw the conclusion
Write the Embedded C Program and Assembly Program for Wave Drive Stepper Motor System. And observe the output in the Proteus
Write the Embedded C Program and Assembly Program for Half Wave Drive Stepper Motor System. And observe the output in the Proteus.
